steps.text: Rinse the rice, then cook it with 3 cups of water: bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low.
Stir the tamari, maple syrup, cornstarch and 2 tablespoons of water together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring now and then, until no longer pink inside.
Add the ginger and cook for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and stir until glossy.
Divide the rice between bowls. Top with the chicken, grated carrot, cucumber and green onion tops.

title: Herb roast chicken with potatoes and carrots

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a sheet pan with foil or parchment.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with half the oil, half the herbs and half the salt. Spread them on the pan.
Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil, herbs, paprika, salt and pepper. Nestle it between the vegetables.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are golden.
Scatter the parsley over the top and serve.

title: Dill salmon with potatoes and green beans

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and a pinch of salt on a sheet pan. Roast while you prep the fish.
Pat the salmon dry and season with salt, pepper and half the dill. Toss the green beans with the rest of the oil.
Push the potatoes to one side, add the salmon and green beans, and roast until the salmon flakes easily.
Sprinkle with the remaining dill and serve.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a sheet pan.
Start the rice: simmer it covered with 2½ cups of water.
Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the parsley, Italian seasoning and salt. Roll into 16 balls.
Bake the meatballs until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside).
Sauté the zucchini in the oil until just tender, then stir it into the cooked rice with the rest of the parsley.
Serve the meatballs over the rice.
Warm the oil in a large pot and cook the carrots for a few minutes.
Add the broth, whole chicken breasts, thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the rice to the pot and simmer until tender.
Return the chicken, remove the bay leaf, season with salt and stir in the parsley.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with the oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan and roast.
Stir the mustard, maple syrup and thyme together. Brush it all over the pork.
Add the pork and green beans to the pan. Roast until the pork reads 145°F (63°C) inside.
Rest the pork for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the vegetables.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Toss the beef with 1 teaspoon of the cornstarch. Mix the rest of the cornstarch with the tamari, maple syrup and ½ cup water.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Sear the beef in one layer until browned, then move it to a plate.
Add the broccoli and 2 tablespoons of water. Cover and steam until bright green.
Add the ginger, the beef and the sauce. Stir until the sauce thickens.
Serve over the rice.

title: Chicken quinoa bowls with tahini drizzle

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it covered in 2 cups of water until the water is absorbed.
Season the chicken with cumin and salt.
Cook the chicken in the oil over medium heat, turning once, until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Whisk the tahini, maple syrup, a pinch of salt and 3 tablespoons of warm water into a pourable sauce.
Build bowls with spinach, quinoa, chicken, cucumber and carrot. Drizzle with the tahini sauce.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a large pan over high heat. Cook the shrimp until pink, then set aside.
Add the eggs, scramble until just set, and set aside with the shrimp.
Add the rest of the oil, the carrots and peas. Stir-fry until the carrots soften.
Add the rice and press it into the pan. Let it crisp, then stir.
Return the shrimp and eggs, add the tamari and sesame oil, and toss. Top with green onion tops.
Brown the turkey in the oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, oregano, salt and ¼ cup water. Simmer until saucy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill each tortilla with turkey, lettuce, cheese and cilantro.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes and carrots with 1 tablespoon of oil and half the salt. Roast.
Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley, the rest of the oil and salt.
Pat the cod dry, place it on the pan and press the crumb mix on top.
Roast until the fish flakes easily and the crumbs are golden.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Whisk the tamari, maple syrup, vinegar, ginger, cornstarch and ¼ cup water.
Brown the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat until cooked through.
Steam the broccoli in a covered pan with a splash of water.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer until thick and shiny.
Serve over rice with broccoli. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Toss the chicken with the cumin, paprika, oregano and salt.
Heat half the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook the peppers until charred at the edges, then set aside.
Add the rest of the oil and the chicken. Cook until browned and cooked through.
Return the peppers and toss. Warm the tortillas.
Serve the chicken and peppers in tortillas with cilantro.

title: Pork chops with mashed potatoes and glazed carrots

steps.text: Cover the potatoes with salted water, bring to a boil and simmer until a knife slides in easily.
Simmer the carrots in a small pan with ½ cup water, the maple syrup and half the butter until glazed.
Season the pork chops with thyme, salt and pepper.
Cook the chops in the oil over medium-high heat, about 4 minutes a side, until 145°F (63°C) inside.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the milk, the rest of the butter and a pinch of salt.
Serve the chops with the mash and carrots.

title: Glazed salmon with bok choy and rice

steps.text: Start the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix the tamari, maple syrup and ginger.
Place the salmon on a lined pan, spoon over half the glaze and bake until it flakes.
Cook the bok choy in the sesame oil with a splash of water, covered, until tender-crisp.
Brush the salmon with the remaining glaze, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice and bok choy.
Cook the carrots and parsnip in the oil in a large pot for a few minutes.
Add the broth, chicken and thyme. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken and shred it.
Add the pasta and cook until just tender.
Return the chicken, season with salt, and finish with chopped parsley.

title: One-pan beef and rice with vegetables

steps.text: Brown the beef in a large deep pan over medium-high heat. Pour off any extra fat.
Stir in the carrots, paprika, oregano and salt.
Add the rice and broth. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender.
Stir in the zucchini, cover again and cook until soft.
Sprinkle with cheddar and serve.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil over medium heat until just set. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, carrots, pepper and peas. Stir-fry over high heat until tender.
Add the rice and let it crisp before stirring.
Stir in the eggs, tamari and sesame oil. Top with green onion tops.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Toss the tofu cubes in the cornstarch.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat, turning, until crisp on all sides. Set aside.
Stir-fry the carrots and pepper, then the bok choy, until tender-crisp.
Add the ginger, tamari, maple syrup and tofu. Toss and serve over rice.

title: Soft polenta with roasted vegetables and feta

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, oregano and half the salt. Roast until browned.
Bring 4 cups of water and the rest of the salt to a boil.
Whisk in the polenta slowly, then cook on low, stirring often, until thick.
Stir the parmesan into the polenta. Spoon into bowls, top with vegetables, feta and torn basil.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Simmer the quinoa in 1½ cups of water, covered, until absorbed.
Stir the spinach, cumin, paprika, salt and half the cheese into the hot quinoa.
Brush the pepper halves with oil, fill them with the quinoa and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until the peppers are tender and the cheese is melted.
Top with cilantro.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Scrub the potatoes, prick them with a fork and rub with oil and salt.
Bake directly on the rack until soft when squeezed.
Steam the broccoli until tender.
Split the potatoes and fluff the insides with a fork.
Set out broccoli, cheddar, Greek yogurt and chives so everyone builds their own.

title: Chicken souvlaki bowls with dill yogurt

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the oil, vinegar, oregano and most of the salt. Let it sit while you start the rice.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze out the water and stir it into the yogurt with the dill and a pinch of salt. Dice the rest.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Build bowls with rice, lettuce, diced cucumber and chicken. Spoon over the dill yogurt.
Mix the turkey, mustard, paprika and salt. Shape into 4 patties, pressing a dimple in the center of each.
Cook in the oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lay a slice of Swiss on each patty for the last minute so it melts.
Toast the buns and build burgers with lettuce and cucumber.

title: Paprika chicken thighs with potatoes and green beans

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and salt. Rub the chicken with the paprika, oregano, the rest of the oil and salt.
Roast the chicken and potatoes together.
Add the green beans to the pan and roast until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Cook the rice with 2¼ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat.
Add the curry powder, turmeric and ginger. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and broth, add the salt, and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

title: Miso-glazed cod with rice and bok choy

steps.text: Start the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Heat the broiler. Mix the miso, maple syrup and vinegar and spread it over the cod.
Broil the cod 6 inches from the heat until it flakes and the top is browned in spots.
Cook the bok choy in the sesame oil with a splash of water, covered.
Serve the cod with rice and bok choy, topped with green onion tops.
Soak or cook the rice noodles following the package, then rinse under cold water.
Stir the fish sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar and 2 tablespoons of water into a dressing.
Cook the shrimp in the oil over medium-high heat until pink.
Divide the noodles between bowls. Top with shrimp, carrot, cucumber, cilantro and peanuts.
Spoon the dressing over each bowl.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a deep skillet. Set aside.
Add the carrots, rice, thyme, salt and broth. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in the milk, peas and chicken. Simmer uncovered until creamy and the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the parmesan and serve.

title: Crispy baked chicken tenders with carrot fries

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line two sheet pans.
Toss the carrot fries with 1 tablespoon of oil and half the salt. Roast on one pan.
Beat the egg in a bowl. Mix the breadcrumbs, paprika, parmesan and the rest of the salt in another.
Dip each tender in egg, then press into the crumbs. Lay on the second pan and drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Bake until golden and cooked through, turning once.
Stir the mustard and maple syrup together for dipping.
Set the pressure cooker to sauté. Brown the beef in the oil in two batches.
Add the broth and scrape up the browned bits. Add the vegetables, thyme, bay leaves and salt.
Seal and pressure-cook on high, then let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes.
Mix the cornstarch with 3 tablespoons of cold water.
Switch back to sauté, stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer until thickened. Remove the bay leaves.
Cook the rice noodles following the package. Drain and rinse.
Stir-fry the pork in the vegetable oil over high heat until no longer pink.
Add the ginger, bok choy and carrot. Stir-fry until the bok choy wilts.
Add the noodles, tamari, maple syrup and sesame oil. Toss well and serve.

title: Salmon rice bowls with cucumber and carrot

steps.text: Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered. Stir in the rice vinegar when done.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush the salmon with 1 tablespoon of tamari and the sesame oil.
Bake until it flakes easily, then break into large pieces.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber and carrot. Drizzle with the rest of the tamari, then top with sesame seeds and green onion tops.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the turkey in the oil over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetables, Italian seasoning and salt. Cook until tender.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve over rice.

title: Lentil and rice bowls with tahini

steps.text: Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Warm the lentils in the oil with the cumin and a pinch of salt.
Whisk the tahini, maple syrup, salt and 4 tablespoons of warm water.
Build bowls with spinach, rice, lentils and carrot. Drizzle with tahini and scatter parsley.
Cook the carrots in the oil in a large pot for a few minutes.
Add the potatoes, broth, thyme and salt. Bring to a boil.
Simmer until everything is very soft.
Blend until smooth (carefully, in batches, or with a stick blender). Stir in the coconut milk.
Top with snipped chives and serve with toast.
Cook the noodles following the package. Drain and rinse.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat until golden.
Whisk the peanut butter, tamari, maple syrup, vinegar, ginger and 4 tablespoons of hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce. Top with tofu, carrot and cucumber.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Whisk the eggs, milk and salt.
Cook the potatoes in the oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat until tender.
Add the pepper and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts.
Pour in the eggs and crumble the feta on top.
Bake until the center is just set.
Slice and serve with the spring mix.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Toss the chicken and vegetables with the oil, oregano and salt. Thread onto skewers with the pineapple.
Grill over medium-high heat, turning every few minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the kabobs over rice.
Simmer the broth with the ginger slices and carrots.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through.
Add the bok choy and simmer until tender. Stir in the fish sauce.
Cook the noodles separately following the package and divide between bowls.
Ladle the soup over the noodles, removing the ginger slices. Top with green onion tops and cilantro.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon of oil and half the salt. Roast.
Season the salmon with lemon zest, salt and pepper. Toss the zucchini with the rest of the oil.
Add the salmon, zucchini and lemon slices to the pan. Roast until the salmon flakes.
Finish with chopped dill and parsley and a squeeze of the roasted lemon.
Toss the chicken with the juice of 1 lime, the cumin, paprika and salt.
Cook in the oil over medium-high heat until charred and cooked through, about 5 minutes a side.
Rest for 5 minutes, then chop.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of the second lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas and fill with chicken, cabbage and cilantro.
Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water until just tender.
Meanwhile, warm the garlic-infused oil, add the passata, oregano, sugar and salt, and simmer.
Save ½ cup of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, a splash of pasta water and most of the basil.
Serve with parmesan and the rest of the basil.
Toss the coleslaw mix with the mayonnaise, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Season the shrimp with paprika, cumin and salt.
Cook the shrimp in the oil over high heat until pink.
Warm the tortillas and fill with shrimp, slaw and cilantro.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Heat the oil with the chili flakes. Add the chicken and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the pepper and green beans and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Stir in the tamari, fish sauce and sugar, then fold in the basil until wilted.
Serve over rice.
Brown the beef in the garlic-infused oil, breaking it up.
Add the carrot, passata, Italian seasoning and salt.
Simmer, stirring now and then, while the pasta cooks.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until just tender. Drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with parmesan.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Oil a sheet pan.
Dip the cutlets in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs mixed with half the parmesan and the Italian seasoning.
Bake the cutlets until golden.
Spoon passata over each cutlet and top with mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan.
Bake again until the cheese bubbles.
Meanwhile cook the pasta, then toss it with the remaining passata. Serve with the chicken and basil.
Simmer the broth with the chicken and carrots until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken and shred it.
Add the rice to the broth and simmer until tender.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice. Slowly whisk in a cup of hot broth, then stir it all back into the pot over low heat (do not boil).
Return the chicken, season with salt and finish with dill.
Cook the pepper in the garlic-infused oil in a wide pan until soft.
Add the cumin and paprika for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes and salt. Simmer until thickened.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Crumble feta and parsley over the top. Serve with toasted sourdough.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lay the wraps on two sheet pans.
Spread each with passata, sprinkle with oregano, then top with mozzarella, pepper and olives.
Bake until the edges are crisp and the cheese bubbles.
Toss the greens with the olive oil and serve on the side.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Oil a sheet pan.
Dip the cod in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs mixed with paprika and a pinch of salt.
Bake until crisp and the fish flakes.
Mix the yogurt with the juice of 1 lime. Toss the slaw with the juice of the other lime.
Fill warm tortillas with cod, slaw, a spoonful of lime yogurt and cilantro.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water. Save ½ cup of the water, then drain.
Cook the shrimp in the garlic-infused oil with the chili flakes until pink.
Add the spinach, lemon zest and juice, and the pasta with a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy.
Finish with parsley and parmesan.
Toss the chicken with the yogurt, half the garam masala, the turmeric and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice with 2¼ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger, cayenne and the rest of the garam masala, then the tomatoes. Simmer.
Stir in the coconut milk and simmer until the chicken is cooked through. Serve with rice.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water. Stir in the lime juice and half the cilantro when done.
Brown the beef. Add the cumin, chipotle and salt, then the tomatoes. Simmer until thick.
Build bowls with rice, beef, lettuce and cheese. Top with the rest of the cilantro.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Season the chicken with Italian seasoning and salt.
Sear the chicken in the oil in an oven-safe pan until browned and cooked through.
Top each piece with tomato and mozzarella. Broil until the cheese melts.
Scatter basil, drizzle with balsamic and serve with the potatoes.
Season the chicken with half the oregano and salt.
Cook it in 1 teaspoon of oil until cooked through. Rest and slice.
Whisk the rest of the oil with the lemon juice and the rest of the oregano.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes and olives with the dressing. Top with chicken and feta.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, dill, cucumber and salt.
Spoon into lettuce cups and serve with crackers.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Mix the salmon, egg, breadcrumbs, mustard, lemon zest and half the chives. Shape into 8 patties.
Fry the patties in the oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Stir the lemon juice and the rest of the chives into the yogurt.
Serve the cakes with the lemon yogurt, greens and potatoes.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Toss the tofu in the cornstarch.
Fry the tofu in the oil until crisp on all sides. Set aside.
Steam the broccoli in the same pan with a splash of water, covered.
Stir together the lemon zest and juice, ginger, tamari and maple syrup. Pour into the pan, add the tofu and toss until glossy.
Serve over rice.
Fry the crumbled tofu in the oil over medium-high heat until golden.
Add the chipotle, cumin, paprika, tamari and juice of 1 lime. Toss until coated.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of the other lime and a pinch of salt.
Fill warm tortillas with tofu, cabbage and cilantro.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the tofu in the oil. Add the pepper and cook until soft.
Stir in the ginger, curry powder and cayenne for 30 seconds, then the coconut milk. Simmer.
Stir in the spinach and lime juice. Season with salt and serve over rice.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Boil the pasta for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
Mix the pasta with the passata, oil, Italian seasoning, salt, half the mozzarella and torn basil.
Spread in a baking dish and top with the rest of the mozzarella and the parmesan.
Bake until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with the olive oil and half the salt. Roast until crisp.
Finely chop the parsley and mix with the oregano, vinegar, garlic-infused oil, chili flakes and a pinch of salt.
Season the steak with salt. Sear in a very hot pan, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Rest for 5 minutes, slice against the grain and spoon over the chimichurri.
Rub the pork with the cumin, oregano and salt.
Put the pork in the pressure cooker with the orange juice, the juice of 1 lime and ½ cup water.
Pressure-cook on high, then release the pressure.
Shred the pork with two forks.
Crisp the shredded pork in the oil in a hot pan, adding a splash of the cooking liquid.
Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro, radishes and lime wedges.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the vegetables with half the oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil, lemon zest, plenty of pepper and salt. Add it to the pan.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
Squeeze lemon juice over everything before serving.
Cook the pepper in the oil until soft.
Add the spices, rice, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender.
Nestle the shrimp into the rice, cover and cook until pink.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Oil two sheet pans.
Dip the eggplant in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumbs mixed with half the parmesan.
Bake until golden, flipping halfway.
Layer the eggplant in a dish with passata, mozzarella and basil, finishing with cheese.
Bake until bubbling.
Cook the pasta to serve alongside.
Cook the eggplant in the oil in a large pot until browned.
Add the zucchini and pepper and cook a few minutes more.
Add the tomatoes, thyme and half the salt. Simmer until thick.
Whisk the polenta into 4 cups of boiling salted water and cook on low, stirring often.
Serve the ratatouille over polenta with torn basil.
Simmer the tomatoes with the jalapeño, cumin and a pinch of salt until saucy.
Warm the beans in a small pan.
Crisp the tortillas in a little oil, then fry the eggs to your liking in the rest.
Top two tortillas per plate with beans, eggs, sauce, cheese and cilantro.
Cook the bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Lift it out, leaving 1 tablespoon of fat.
Add the potatoes, paprika and salt. Cook, turning now and then, until crisp and tender.
Add the pepper and cook until soft. Stir the bacon back in.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.
Top with chives.

title: Lemon dill cod with rice and green beans

steps.text: Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Steam the green beans until tender.
Season the cod with salt and cook in the oil over medium heat until it flakes, turning once.
Add the butter, lemon juice and dill to the pan and spoon over the fish.
Serve with rice and green beans.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the chicken with the spices, oil, half the lemon juice and a good pinch of salt.
Roast until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Cook the rice with 2¼ cups of water, covered, on low.
Mix the yogurt with the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Slice the chicken and build bowls with rice, cucumber, tomatoes, parsley and lemon yogurt.
Cook the noodles following the package. Drain and rinse.
Fry the tofu in the vegetable oil until golden.
Whisk the tahini, tamari, vinegar, maple syrup, chili flakes, sesame oil, lime juice and 3 tablespoons of hot water.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, then top with tofu and cucumber.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Boil the pasta for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
Brown the turkey in the oil, then add the passata, Italian seasoning and salt. Simmer.
Mix the pasta with the sauce and half the mozzarella. Spread in a baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until bubbling.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Toss the chicken with 2 tablespoons of cornstarch.
Fry the chicken in the oil until golden and cooked through.
Mix the zest of 1 orange, the juice of both, tamari, maple syrup, ginger, vinegar and the rest of the cornstarch.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer until thick. Steam the broccoli on the side.
Serve over rice with broccoli.
Cook the pepper in the oil until soft.
Add the rinsed quinoa, spices, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until the quinoa is tender.
Stir in the corn and lime juice and warm through. Top with cilantro.

title: Lemon herb chicken thighs and potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes and chicken with the oil, lemon juice and zest, herbs and salt in a roasting dish.
Roast until the potatoes are golden.
Add the green beans for the last part of cooking until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush the salmon with tamari.
Bake until it flakes, then break into pieces.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha and lime juice.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber and carrot. Drizzle with the spicy mayo and sesame seeds.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble softly in half the oil. Set aside.
Cook the tomatoes in the rest of the oil until juicy.
Stir in the sugar and tamari, return the eggs and fold gently.
Top with green onion tops and serve over rice.
Cook the carrots in the garlic-infused oil for a few minutes.
Add the broth, tomatoes and Italian seasoning. Simmer.
Add the zucchini, kale, lentils and pasta. Simmer until the pasta is tender.
Season with salt and serve with parmesan if you like.
Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil in a large pot.
Add the broth, chicken and thyme. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Add the noodles and simmer until tender.
Return the chicken, season with salt and finish with parsley.

title: Garlic herb roast chicken and potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything with the oil, herbs and salt on a large sheet pan, with the chicken skin side up.
Roast until the chicken reaches 175°F (80°C) and the potatoes are golden.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the turkey, onion, panko, egg, 2 tablespoons of milk, thyme, 1 tablespoon of mustard and 1 teaspoon of salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined pan.
Stir the rest of the mustard with the maple syrup and brush it over the loaf.
Bake until 165°F (74°C) in the center.
Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter, the rest of the milk and salt.
Rest the meatloaf for 10 minutes, slice and serve with the mash.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Season the chicken and cook it in the oil until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the same pan until browned. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour, then slowly stir in the milk, broth and thyme.
Simmer until thickened, then return the chicken to warm through.
Serve over rice.
Soften the onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the garlic and rosemary for 30 seconds.
Add the beans and 1.5 liters of water with 2 teaspoons of salt. Simmer.
Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken, then add the kale and simmer until tender.
Serve with toasted sourdough.
Cook the pasta in salted water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Cook the chicken in the oil until cooked through. Set aside.
Melt the butter, stir in the garlic and flour, then slowly whisk in the milk.
Simmer until thickened, then stir in the parmesan.
Toss the pasta, broccoli and chicken with the sauce.
Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add the cumin and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Add the lentils and broth. Simmer until the vegetables are soft.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in. Season and top with parsley.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix the honey, soy sauce and garlic and spoon over the salmon.
Bake until the salmon flakes.
Steam the green beans.
Serve with sesame seeds sprinkled on top.
Season the chicken with cumin and salt.
Cook in the oil until cooked through, then slice.
Spread each tortilla with hummus, add lettuce, cucumber and chicken, and roll up tightly.
Cook the rice with 2¼ cups of water, covered, on low.
Soften the onion in the oil. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season with salt and serve over rice.
Cook the noodles in salted water. Drain.
Sear the beef in half the oil over high heat. Set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the rest of the oil until golden.
Stir in the flour, then the broth and mustard. Simmer until thickened.
Take off the heat, stir in the yogurt and beef, and serve over noodles with parsley.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Season the chops with salt and thyme and sear in the oil until cooked through. Set aside.
Cook the apple and onion in the same pan until soft and golden.
Add the vinegar and 2 tablespoons of water, scrape up the browned bits and spoon over the chops.
Brown the turkey with the onion.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the beans and broth. Simmer.
Mash some beans to thicken, stir in the corn, and serve with cheese and cilantro.

title: Vegetable fried rice with snap peas and mushrooms

steps.text: Scramble the eggs in a little oil. Set aside.
Stir-fry the onion, mushrooms and snap peas in the rest of the oil. Add the garlic.
Add the rice and let it crisp.
Stir in the eggs, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with the oil, spices and salt. Roast until browned.
Simmer the quinoa in 2 cups of water, covered.
Thin the tahini with warm water and a pinch of salt.
Build bowls with spinach, quinoa and the roasted vegetables. Drizzle with tahini.

title: Sweet potato and black bean bowls

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the sweet potato with the oil, spices and salt and roast until tender.
Cook the brown rice with 2 cups of water, covered.
Warm the beans with the onion in a small pan.
Build bowls with rice, sweet potato and beans. Top with cilantro.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the chicken in the oil, about 5 minutes a side.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic and vinegar and pour it in.
Simmer, turning the chicken, until sticky and cooked through. Steam the broccoli on the side.
Season the chicken with oregano and salt and cook in the oil until done.
Grate half the cucumber into the yogurt with the dill and a pinch of salt. Slice the rest.
Warm the pitas and fill with lettuce, chicken, sliced cucumber, onion and dill yogurt.
Cook the pasta in salted water, adding the asparagus for the last 3 minutes. Save ½ cup of water and drain.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Toss in the pasta, asparagus, parmesan and enough pasta water to make it glossy.
Cook the onions slowly in the oil with a pinch of salt until golden and soft.
Shape the turkey into 8 small patties and season with salt.
Cook the patties until cooked through, adding the cheese at the end to melt.
Build sliders with mustard and a pile of onions.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until just tender.
Warm the garlic in the oil until fragrant, then add the marinara and simmer.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce. Serve with basil and parmesan.
Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and 1 cup of water. Simmer, stirring now and then.
Season with salt. Serve with cheddar and sour cream.
Brown the beef with the onion.
Add the spices, a pinch of salt and ¼ cup water. Simmer until saucy.
Warm the tortillas and fill with beef, lettuce, cheese and salsa.
Shape the beef into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot skillet, about 4 minutes a side, adding the cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns and build burgers with the toppings.
Brown the sausages in the oil, turning, then add ¼ cup water, cover and cook through.
Add the peppers and onion and cook until soft and browned.
Serve the sausages in buns piled with peppers and onions.

title: BBQ chicken with corn and potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with the oil and salt and roast.
Add the chicken and corn. Brush the chicken with half the BBQ sauce and roast.
Brush with the rest of the sauce and roast until sticky and cooked through.
Poach the chicken in simmering water until cooked, then shred.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the garlic and spices, then the tomatoes. Simmer to make the sauce.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix the chicken with 1 cup of sauce and half the cheese.
Roll the filling in tortillas and lay them in a baking dish. Cover with the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Bake until bubbling. Top with cilantro.
Boil the lasagna sheets until just flexible. Drain and lay flat.
Brown the turkey, then stir in the marinara.
Mix the ricotta, egg, spinach and half the parmesan. Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Layer sauce, pasta, ricotta mix and mozzarella in a 9×13 dish, three times, ending with sauce and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake, then uncover and bake until golden.
Rest for 15 minutes before cutting.
Soak the noodles following the package. Mix the fish sauce, sugar, juice of 1 lime and chili flakes.
Stir-fry the shrimp and garlic in the oil until pink. Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss until the noodles are tender.
Toss in the sprouts and green onions. Serve with peanuts and lime wedges.
Cook the rice with 2¼ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the chicken in the butter. Set aside.
Soften the onion, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer. Blend smooth if you like.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer until cooked through. Serve with rice.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Spread the pitas with marinara and top with torn mozzarella.
Bake until the cheese melts.
Top with basil. Serve with dressed greens.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Sear the beef in the oil over high heat. Set aside.
Stir-fry the snow peas, garlic and ginger.
Mix the soy, hoisin, cornstarch and ¼ cup water, add with the beef and toss until glossy.
Season and cook the chicken in the oil until done. Slice.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, mustard and half the parmesan.
Toss the chopped romaine with the dressing and the rest of the parmesan.
Fill the tortillas with salad and chicken and roll up.
Cook the pasta. Save ½ cup of water, then drain.
Cook the chicken in the oil until done.
Toss the pasta with the chicken, pesto, halved tomatoes and a splash of pasta water. Top with parmesan.
Lightly mash the beans with the cumin and corn.
Spread the beans over 4 tortillas, top with cheese and the remaining tortillas.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.
Soften the onion and pepper in the oil.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes and 1 cup of water. Simmer until thick.
Season and top with cilantro.
Cook the mushrooms and onion in the oil until golden. Season and set aside.
Shape and cook the turkey patties until cooked through. Top with Swiss to melt.
Serve on buns with mustard and the mushrooms.
Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Stir in the ketchup, tomato paste, mustard, sugar and ¼ cup water. Simmer until thick.
Spoon onto toasted buns. Serve with coleslaw mix on the side.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Cook the sliced chicken with the spices in the oil until done. Set aside.
Char the onion and peppers in the same pan.
Build bowls with rice, chicken, vegetables, salsa and sour cream.
Cook the pasta. Save ½ cup of water, then drain.
Melt the butter and cook the garlic gently until golden. Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Toss in the pasta, soy sauce, parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Top with green onions.
Soften the onion in a little of the broth. Add the garlic and spices.
Add the rest of the broth, tomatoes and chicken. Simmer until cooked through.
Shred the chicken, then return it with the beans and corn. Heat through and add the lime juice.
Serve topped with crushed chips and avocado.
Cook the pasta. Save ½ cup of water, then drain.
Warm the garlic and chili flakes in the oil, add the tomatoes and beans, and simmer.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then toss with the pasta, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and oil a sheet pan.
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and 1 teaspoon of salt in a food processor until coarse.
Shape into 16 small patties, brush with oil and bake, flipping once, until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and water until pourable.
Fill the pitas with falafel, cucumber, tomato and tahini sauce.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Toss the chicken in 2 tablespoons of cornstarch and fry in the oil until golden.
Mix the honey, soy, garlic, sesame oil, the rest of the cornstarch and ¼ cup water.
Pour over the chicken and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli alongside.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice.
Soften the onion in 1 tablespoon of butter, then add the garlic and basil.
Add the tomatoes and 1 cup of water and simmer.
Blend until smooth and stir in the milk. Season with salt.
Make sandwiches with the cheese, butter the outsides and cook in a skillet until golden.
Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then slowly whisk in the milk.
Simmer until thickened, then stir in the cheese, mustard powder and salt until smooth.
Fold in the pasta and broccoli.
Cook the rice with 2 cups of water, covered, on low.
Warm the beans in a small pan.
Fill each tortilla with rice, beans, cheese, lettuce and salsa. Fold in the sides and roll.
Toast the burritos seam-side down in a dry pan until golden.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the beef, then add the garlic and ginger.
Stir in the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and chili flakes and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with sliced cucumber and green onions.
Poach the chicken in simmering salted water until cooked, then cool and chop.
Mash the avocado with the yogurt, lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Fold in the chicken and onion.
Build sandwiches with lettuce.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix the turkey, onion, garlic, panko, oregano, egg and salt. Roll into 16 balls.
Bake until cooked through.
Mix the yogurt with grated cucumber and dill.
Fill warm pitas with meatballs, tomato and the yogurt sauce.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Roast the potatoes tossed in oil and salt.
Add the salmon spread with pesto and the asparagus. Roast until the salmon flakes.
Squeeze lemon over the top.
Cook the pasta and drain.
Brown the sausage, breaking it up.
Add the marinara and simmer, then stir in the spinach.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan.
Cook the pasta. Save ½ cup of water, then drain.
Cook the garlic and chili in the butter and oil, then add the shrimp until pink.
Add the lemon juice, pasta and a splash of pasta water. Toss with parsley.
Brown the chicken in the oil. Set aside.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms until soft, then the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and chicken. Simmer, covered, until tender.
Whisk the polenta into 4 cups of boiling salted water and cook, stirring often.
Serve the chicken over the polenta.

title: Honey mustard chicken with roasted cauliflower

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the cauliflower and potatoes with the oil and salt and roast.
Mix the honey and mustard and brush over the chicken.
Add the chicken to the pan and roast until 165°F (74°C).
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Fry the cubed tofu in half the oil until golden. Set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables and garlic in the rest of the oil.
Add the tofu, hoisin and soy and toss.
Brown the beef with the cumin and a pinch of salt.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Spread the chips on a sheet pan and top with beef, beans and cheese.
Bake until the cheese melts.
Top with salsa, sour cream and sliced jalapeño.

title: Chicken pot pie with biscuit top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Soften the onion, carrot and celery in 2 tablespoons of butter. Add the chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Stir in ¼ cup of the flour, then the broth, ½ cup milk and thyme. Simmer until thick. Add the peas.
Mix the rest of the flour with the baking powder and ½ teaspoon salt. Cut in the rest of the butter, then stir in the rest of the milk.
Pour the filling into a baking dish and drop spoonfuls of biscuit dough on top.
Bake until the biscuits are golden.
Soften the onion, celery and carrot in the oil. Add the garlic.
Add the broth, tomatoes and seasoning. Simmer.
Add the zucchini, beans and pasta and simmer until the pasta is tender.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything with the oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt in a roasting dish.
Roast until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are golden.
Cook the pasta. Save 1 cup of water, then drain.
Warm the garlic in the oil, then wilt the spinach.
Stir in the ricotta, lemon zest, nutmeg, parmesan and enough pasta water to make it creamy. Toss with the pasta.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Thread chunks of chicken, pineapple, onion and pepper onto skewers.
Grill, turning and brushing with BBQ sauce, until the chicken is cooked through.
Dice the mango, onion and jalapeño and mix with lime juice and cilantro.
Season the shrimp with chipotle and salt and cook in the oil until pink.
Fill warm tortillas with shrimp and mango salsa.
Cook the rice with 2 cups of water, covered, on low.
Brown the pork, then add the garlic and ginger.
Add the coleslaw mix and soy sauce and cook until just wilted.
Finish with sesame oil, sriracha and green onions. Serve with rice.
Cook the bacon until crisp. Crumble and set aside, keeping 1 tablespoon of fat.
Soften the onion in the fat, then add the garlic, potatoes and broth. Simmer until soft.
Mash or blend part of the soup, stir in the milk and most of the cheese.
Top with bacon, the rest of the cheese and chives.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water. Stir in the lime juice when done.
Season the chicken and cook in the oil until done. Slice.
Warm the beans and corn together.
Build bowls with rice, chicken, beans, corn, salsa and avocado.
Cook the rice with 2½ cups of water, covered, on low.
Fry the curry paste in a splash of the coconut milk for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chicken, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar. Simmer.
Add the pepper and snow peas and simmer until tender-crisp.
Stir in the basil and lime juice. Serve with rice.
Cook the pasta, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, garlic and a pinch of salt.
Toss the pasta with halved tomatoes, torn mozzarella, basil and the dressing.
Cook the onion and pepper in half the oil until soft. Set aside.
Sear the beef in the rest of the oil over high heat, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Return the vegetables, divide into 4 piles and top with cheese until melted.
Scoop each pile into a toasted roll.
Crisp the hash browns in 1 tablespoon of oil.
Cook the diced pepper, then scramble the eggs with it in the rest of the oil.
Fill the tortillas with hash browns, eggs, cheese and salsa and roll up.
